$schema.description: Points editors at the generated JSON Schema, for autocomplete.

clarity_lift_s.description:
For a machine that cleans water: seconds it takes to lift the water below it one
clarity level while it works, and to let it fall back when it stops.

clock_reach_m.description: How far, in metres, a machine with a borrowed clock reaches for a running one.

machine.description: The machine kind these settings are for: its placed asset ID.

targets.description: The knobs its work needs, all at once (the campfire lights only with these met).

MachineTarget.description:
A knob a machine's work needs set: in a rack place, at a note (`C2`, for a semitone
knob) or at a value (`1`, a step gate on). Give one of `note` or `value`.

knob.description: The knob, as the module's data names it (`gate_2`, `freq`).

place.description: The rack place (`seq`, `vco_low`), as the machine's profile names it.
